The target video is a live-action, cinematic music-video segment presented in widescreen, with anamorphic lens flares, saturated neon practical lights, and a cool cyan-and-magenta palette balanced against warm skin tones.
[Shot 1] A wide, slightly low-angle shot opens on a rooftop at night above a dense city skyline. Wet concrete underfoot mirrors the surrounding neon signage, a thin layer of mist drifts through the air, and the moon sits high above the towers on the left side of the frame. A young woman in her early twenties, with shoulder-length dark hair, a silver-sequined cropped jacket over a black top, wide-leg dark trousers, and small silver earrings, stands at the rooftop edge with her back to the camera and the skyline spread out beyond her. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she turns her head, steps forward onto the first heavy downbeat, and drops into a sharp, controlled dance phrase. Her arms cut across the neon glow, her jacket scatters small points of reflected light, and loose strands of hair lift and settle with each hit. Behind her the city lights pulse red and blue while she keeps her weight low and her gaze toward the lens.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.750, the shot cuts on the downbeat to a medium-wide tracking shot at street level, where the same woman continues the routine on a rain-slicked street lined with glowing storefront signs. The camera trucks left at slow speed, holding her in the left third of the frame as she spins once, lands on both feet, and drives both hands upward with the rhythm. Neon reflections stretch and slide across the wet asphalt beneath her, and a light spray of water lifts from her heels on each landing. She performs without lip-syncing, and her lips never form words. Toward the end of the shot she steps toward the lens, plants her feet wide, and finishes on a held pose, chin lifted and one arm extended toward the sky, landing exactly on the final beat at the ten-second mark. All vocal and instrumental layers come from the reused song <Audio 1>, which plays continuously across both shots without interruption.
